parameters.query:
-- Pick users with NEW (un-notified) matches and create one PENDING notification each.
-- Filters: marketing consent, suppression list, 7-day frequency cap, deliverable address.
-- TEST MODE (the brief: never email sample-CSV addresses): the recipient is rewritten to one of
-- our own Gmail +aliases, one alias per user, capped at $4 users. UNIQUE(user_id, digest_key)
-- makes a re-run a no-op: the same offer set can't be queued twice, and the partial unique index
-- (user_id, cap_week) means two notifiers racing for the same person can't both queue an email.
-- $1 batch_id, $2 test_mode ('true'/'false'), $3 test recipients JSON array, $4 max emails per run
WITH settings AS (
  SELECT $2::boolean AS test_mode, $3::jsonb AS aliases, $4::int AS cap
), candidates AS (
  SELECT m.user_id, u.email, u.email_deliverable,
         array_agg(m.product_id ORDER BY m.score DESC, m.product_id) AS products
  FROM matches m
  JOIN users u USING (user_id)
  WHERE m.batch_id = $1::uuid AND m.notified_at IS NULL AND u.consent_marketing
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM notifications n
                    WHERE n.user_id = m.user_id AND n.status = 'SENT' AND n.sent_at > now() - interval '7 days')
  GROUP BY m.user_id, u.email, u.email_deliverable
), addressed AS (
  SELECT c.*, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY c.user_id) AS rn,
         CASE WHEN s.test_mode
              THEN s.aliases ->> ((row_number() OVER (ORDER BY c.user_id) - 1)::int)
              ELSE c.email END AS recipient
  FROM candidates c CROSS JOIN settings s
  WHERE s.test_mode OR c.email_deliverable
), eligible AS (
  SELECT a.* FROM addressed a CROSS JOIN settings s
  WHERE a.recipient IS NOT NULL
    AND (NOT s.test_mode OR a.rn <= s.cap)
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM suppression x
                    WHERE x.email_hash = encode(sha256(convert_to(lower(a.recipient), 'UTF8')), 'hex'))
), inserted AS (
  INSERT INTO notifications (user_id, batch_id, digest_key, recipient)
  SELECT user_id, $1::uuid, md5(array_to_string(products, ',')), recipient FROM eligible
  ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING          -- either unique rule (same offer, or already emailed this week)
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM candidates) AS users_with_new_matches,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM inserted)   AS queued;

-- Everything the renderer (and the question planner: product_id, status, score, unverified,
-- interest_rate_min, soft_rules; declared = Workflow D answers, so it never asks twice) needs,
-- one item per PENDING notification (bounded: LIMIT 500 per page).
-- $1 batch_id
SELECT n.id AS notification_id, n.user_id, n.recipient, u.name, u.monthly_income, u.credit_score,
       u.employment_status::text AS employment_status, u.age, d.answers AS declared,
       (SELECT json_agg(x ORDER BY x.score DESC)
          FROM (SELECT m.product_id, m.score, m.status, m.unverified, p.soft_rules, p.product_name, p.lender_name, p.source_url,
                       p.interest_rate_min, p.interest_rate_max, p.min_monthly_income, p.min_credit_score,
                       p.min_age, p.max_age, p.employment_types::text[] AS employment_types, p.max_loan_amount
                  FROM matches m JOIN loan_products p ON p.id = m.product_id
                 WHERE m.user_id = n.user_id AND m.notified_at IS NULL) x) AS products
FROM notifications n
JOIN users u USING (user_id)
LEFT JOIN user_declarations d USING (user_id)
WHERE n.batch_id = $1::uuid AND n.status = 'PENDING'
ORDER BY n.id
LIMIT 500;

-- After SES accepted the message. Also stamps the user's matches as notified, so the same
-- offers are never emailed again. $1 notification_id, $2 SES message id,
-- $3 JSON array of question ids the email asked ('' = no question link) — Workflow D serves only these.
WITH sent AS (
  UPDATE notifications SET status = 'SENT', sent_at = now(), ses_message_id = $2, attempts = attempts + 1,
                           questions = nullif($3, '')::jsonb
  WHERE id = $1::bigint AND status = 'PENDING'
  RETURNING user_id
)
UPDATE matches m SET notified_at = now()
FROM sent WHERE m.user_id = sent.user_id AND m.notified_at IS NULL
RETURNING m.product_id;

parameters.query:
-- SES rejected the message (after the node's own retries). Permanent after 3 attempts.
-- $1 notification_id, $2 error text
UPDATE notifications
SET attempts = attempts + 1, last_error = left($2, 500),
    status = CASE WHEN attempts + 1 >= 3 THEN 'FAILED' ELSE 'PENDING' END
WHERE id = $1::bigint
RETURNING id, status;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [String($('Loop one at a time').item.json.notification_id), String($json.error?.message ?? $json.error ?? 'SES error')] }}

parameters.query:
-- Close the batch: counts for the UI, NOTIFYING → DONE. $1 batch_id
WITH counts AS (
  SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'SENT') AS sent,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'FAILED') AS failed,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'PENDING') AS pending
  FROM notifications WHERE batch_id = $1::uuid
), ev AS (
  INSERT INTO pipeline_events (batch_id, stage, status, detail)
  SELECT $1::uuid, 'notify', 'completed', to_jsonb(counts) FROM counts
), done AS (
  UPDATE ingest_batches SET status = 'DONE', updated_at = now()
  WHERE id = $1::uuid AND status = 'NOTIFYING'
)
SELECT * FROM counts;
